title: Homily I — The figures that foretold her

edition.locus: Migne, PG 96 (Paris, 1860), Homily I on the Dormition, cols. 712-713 (PDF leaves 397-398)

source_text: Σὺ γὰρ εἶ ὁ βασιλικὸς θρόνος, ᾧ παρεστήκεισαν ἄγγελοι τὸν ἑαυτῶν ὁρῶντες δεσπότην, καὶ δημιουργὸν ἐποχούμενον. Σὺ Ἐδὲμ νοητὴ κεχρημάτικας τῆς πάλαι ἱερωτέρα καὶ θειοτέρα. Ἐν ἐκείνῃ μὲν γὰρ Ἀδὰμ χοϊκὸς ηὐλίζετο, ἐν σοὶ δὲ Κύριος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ. Σὲ κιβωτὸς προεικόνισε δευτέρου κόσμου σπέρμα φυλάττουσα· σὺ γὰρ τὴν τοῦ κόσμου σωτηρίαν τὸν Χριστὸν ἀπεκύησας, τὸν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μὲν κατακλύσαντα, τὰ δὲ ταύτης κατευνάσαντα κύματα. Σὲ βάτος προέγραψε, πλάκες θεόγραφοι προεχάραξαν, νόμου ἡ κιβωτὸς προϊστόρησε, στάμνος χρυσῆ καὶ λυχνία, καὶ τράπεζα, καὶ ῥάβδος Ἀαρὼν ἡ βλαστήσασα, ἐμφανῶς προετύπωσαν. Ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἡ φλὸξ τῆς θεότητος, ὁ τοῦ Πατρὸς ὅρος καὶ Λόγος, τὸ γλυκύτατον καὶ οὐράνιον μάννα, τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἀνώνυμον τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα, τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀΐδιον καὶ ἀπρόσιτον, ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς ὁ οὐράνιος, ὁ ἀγεώργητος καρπὸς, σωματικῶς ἐκ σοῦ ἀνεβλάστησεν. Οὐ σὲ προεμήνυσε κάμινος, πῦρ δροσίζον ἅμα καὶ φλογίζον δεικνύουσα, καὶ τοῦ θείου πυρὸς ἀντίτυπον τοῦ ἐν σοὶ κατοικήσαντος; Ἡ δὲ σκηνὴ Ἀβραὰμ σὲ προδηλοῖ προφανέστατα. Τῷ γὰρ Θεῷ Λόγῳ ἐν τῇ γαστρί σου σκηνώσαντι ἀνθρωπεία φύσις τὸν ἐγκρυφίαν ἄρτον, τὴν ἑαυτῆς ἀπαρχὴν ἐκ τῶν σῶν ἁγνῶν αἱμάτων προσήγαγεν, ὀπτωμένην πως καὶ ἀρτοποιουμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ θείου πυρὸς, ἐν τῇ θείᾳ αὐτοῦ ὑποστάσει ὑφισταμένην, καὶ εἰς ἀληθῆ ὕπαρξιν ἐρχομένην σώματος ἐψυχωμένου ψυχῇ λογικῇ τε καὶ νοερᾷ. Μικροῦ με καὶ τοῦ Ἰακὼβ ἡ κλίμαξ διέφυγε. Τί γάρ; οὐ παντὶ δῆλον, ὅτι σοῦ προεγράφη καὶ τύπος γνωρίζεται; ὃν τρόπον ἐκεῖνος τεθέαται διὰ τῶν ἄκρων τῆς κλίμακος οὐρανὸν τῇ γῇ συναπτόμενον, καὶ διὰ ταύτης ἀγγέλους κατιόντας καὶ ἀνιόντας, καὶ τὸν ὄντως ἰσχυρὸν, καὶ ἀήττητον, τυπικῶς αὐτῷ προσπαλαίοντα, οὕτως καὶ σὺ μεσιτεύσασα, καὶ κλίμαξ γεγονυῖα τῆς πρὸς ἡμᾶς τοῦ Θεοῦ καταβάσεως, τοῦ τὸ ἀσθενὲς ἡμῶν ἀναλαβόντος φύραμα, καὶ ἑαυτῷ συμπλέξαντος καὶ ἑνώσαντος, καὶ νοῦν ὁρῶντα Θεὸν δεδρακότος τὸν ἄνθρωπον, τὰ διεστῶτα συνήγαγες. Ὅθεν ἄγγελοι μὲν πρὸς αὐτὸν κατῆεσαν, ὡς Θεῷ καὶ Δεσπότῃ λειτουργήσαντες, ἄνθρωποι δὲ ἀγγελικῇ πολιτείᾳ χρησάμενοι, πρὸς οὐρανὸν ἀναρπάζονται.
pass_a_gloss: For you are the royal (βασιλικός) throne, beside which angels stood seeing their own master (δεσπότης) and creator (δημιουργός) riding upon it (ἐποχούμενον). You have been named (κεχρημάτικας) intelligible Eden (Ἐδὲμ νοητή), holier and more divine than the one of old. For in that one earthy (χοϊκός) Adam lodged, but in you the Lord from heaven. An ark (κιβωτός) prefigured (προεικόνισε) you, guarding the seed (σπέρμα) of a second world; for you bore the salvation of the world, Christ, the one who flooded over (κατακλύσαντα) sin and lulled its waves. A bush (βάτος) wrote you beforehand (προέγραψε), God-written tablets engraved beforehand, the ark of the law narrated beforehand, a golden jar (στάμνος) and lampstand and table and the rod of Aaron that budded (βλαστήσασα) manifestly foretyped (προετύπωσαν). For from you the flame (φλόξ) of the Godhead (θεότης), the boundary/definition (ὅρος) and Word of the Father, the sweetest and heavenly manna, the nameless name (ὄνομα ἀνώνυμον) above every name, the eternal (ἀΐδιον) and unapproachable (ἀπρόσιτον) light, the bread of life the heavenly one, the untilled (ἀγεώργητος) fruit, bodily (σωματικῶς) from you sprouted up (ἀνεβλάστησεν). Did not a furnace (κάμινος) foretell you, showing fire bedewing (δροσίζον) and at once blazing, and antitype (ἀντίτυπον) of the divine fire that dwelt in you? And Abraham's tent (σκηνή) foreshows you most evidently. For to God the Word having tented (σκηνώσαντι) in your womb human nature brought the ash-baked loaf, its own firstfruits (ἀπαρχή) from your pure (ἁγνῶν) bloods, being roasted somehow and made into bread by the divine fire, subsisting (ὑφισταμένην) in his divine hypostasis, and coming into true existence (ὕπαρξις) of a body ensouled with a rational (λογική) and intellectual (νοερά) soul. Almost (μικροῦ) Jacob's ladder (κλίμαξ) escaped me too. For what? Is it not clear to all that it was written beforehand of you and is recognized as type (τύπος)? In the manner that he beheld through the ends of the ladder heaven being joined to the earth, and through it angels descending and ascending, and the truly strong and unconquered one typically (τυπικῶς) wrestling with him, so you also, having mediated (μεσιτεύσασα) and having become a ladder of God's descent (κατάβασις) to us, of him who took up (ἀναλαβόντος) our weak dough-lump (φύραμα) and intertwined and united (ἑνώσαντος) it to himself, and made (δεδρακότος) man a mind seeing God (νοῦς ὁρῶν Θεόν), brought together (συνήγαγες) the things standing apart (τὰ διεστῶτα). Whence angels came down to him, ministering as to God and Master, and men, using an angelic way of life (πολιτεία), are snatched up to heaven.
pass_b_english: For you are the royal throne beside which angels stood, seeing their own Master and Creator seated upon it. You have become a spiritual Eden, holier and more divine than the Eden of old. For in that one dwelt the earthly Adam, but in you the Lord from heaven (1 Corinthians 15:47). The ark foreshadowed you, keeping safe the seed of a second world (Genesis 7:1-3); for you gave birth to Christ, the salvation of the world, who drowned sin and stilled its waves. The bush sketched you in advance (Exodus 3:2); the tablets written by God engraved you beforehand (Exodus 31:18); the ark of the law told your story ahead of time; the golden jar and the lampstand, the table, and the rod of Aaron that budded plainly prefigured you (Hebrews 9:2-4). For from you came the flame of the Godhead, the Father's Definition and Word, the sweetest heavenly manna, the nameless Name that is above every name (Philippians 2:9), the eternal and unapproachable Light (1 Timothy 6:16), the heavenly Bread of life (John 6:48), the fruit no one had tilled: from you he sprang up in the body.

Did not the furnace foretell you, showing a fire that at once bedewed and blazed (Daniel 3:49-50), a figure of the divine fire that dwelt in you? And the tent of Abraham points to you most clearly. For to God the Word, who pitched his tent in your womb (John 1:14), human nature brought the loaf baked in the ashes (Genesis 18:6): its own firstfruits, taken from your pure blood, baked, as it were, and made into bread by the divine fire, subsisting in his divine person, and coming into the true existence of a body given life by a rational and intelligent soul.

Jacob's ladder, too, almost escaped me. What then? Is it not plain to everyone that it was drawn beforehand of you and is known as your figure? Jacob saw heaven joined to earth by the two ends of the ladder, and angels coming down and going up on it (Genesis 28:12), and the One who is truly strong and unconquerable wrestling with him in figure (Genesis 32:24). In the same way you too stood between, and became the ladder of God's coming down to us. He took up our weak lump, wove it into himself and united it to himself, and made man a mind that sees God; and so you brought together what had been parted. That is why angels came down to him, serving him as God and Master, while men, taking up the angelic way of life, are caught up to heaven.

choices.note: Margin marks only Philippians 2:9, John 6:48 and Genesis 28:12; the other citations are clear verbal echoes or named figures: 'earthy Adam ... the Lord from heaven' (1 Corinthians 15:47, χοϊκός);
Noah's ark keeping seed (Genesis 7:1-3 LXX, σπέρμα); the bush (Exodus 3:2);
God-written tablets (Exodus 31:18); the list 'golden jar ... rod of Aaron that budded' and 'lampstand and table' follows the wording of Hebrews 9:2-4;
'unapproachable light' (1 Timothy 6:16);
'pitched his tent' (σκηνώσαντι, John 1:14); the ash-baked loaves of Abraham's tent (ἐγκρυφίας, Genesis 18:6 LXX);
Jacob's wrestling (Genesis 32:24).
The dew in the furnace is in Greek Daniel only (Daniel 3:49-50 in the Greek numbering;
Prayer of Azariah 26-27 in English Bibles that print the Additions).
'The ark of the law' is the ark of the covenant (Exodus 25:10); left with the Hebrews list.
ὅρος in 'the Father's Definition and Word' is the patristic title of the Son as the Father's defining expression (compare Gregory of Nazianzus, Oration 30.20); rendered 'Definition'.
'Made man a mind that sees God' (νοῦν ὁρῶντα Θεόν) plays on the old etymology of Israel, Jacob's new name after the wrestling; left uncited.
'Angels came down to him, serving him' may recall Matthew 4:11; uncertain, uncited.
ὑπόστασις here is rendered 'person' (house usage: 'in his own person' in section 2).
Edition notes: (6) R. reads 'thrones, that is, angels' for 'angels';
δροσίζουσα, δεικνύουσα (feminine participles, same sense);
παναχράντων ('all-immaculate') for ἁγνῶν ('pure');
συγκαταβάσεως ('condescension') for καταβάσεως ('coming down').
English follows the printed text in each case.
φύραμα ('lump', 'dough') kept as 'lump' to hold the bread image.
